articles.headline: Gianni Infantino tells FIFA members to agree to World Cup plan or miss $40m in funding
articles.description: FIFA president Gianni Infantino set a Sept. 19 deadline on Wednesday for the 211 member federations to approve his proposed private investment plan, which would give each association access to up to $40 million in funding.

articles.headline: How college teams embraced World Cup fever in 2026

articles.headline: FA, Concacaf 'deeply concerned' by Gianni Infantino, FIFA's World Cup plan
articles.description: The Football Association and Concacaf have both said they are "deeply concerned" by FIFA's proposed private investment plan
